testimonials.text: Stayed 4 nights in the Deluxe Room, February 2026. The park is literally a 10-minute walk — we did three game drives and saw lions, elephants, and tree-climbing lions. The staff arranged everything for us.
testimonials.author: Sarah & James

testimonials.text: Worked remotely from the Family Cottage for a week. Wi-Fi held up for video calls, the meals were consistently fresh, and the grounds are beautiful. Best value for the area.
testimonials.author: Michael O.

testimonials.text: Weekend safari stopover, December 2025. The cottage was spotless, the staff booked our game drive, and dinner on the terrace was a highlight. Already planning the return.
testimonials.author: Amina K.
